Wolfbeat is a fast desktop music player for Windows, written in Rust: your own music files plus Spotify, YouTube Music and YouTube search in one app.

## Download
1. Download **`Wolfbeat-VERSION-win64.exe`** below.
2. Run it (Windows 10/11, no install, no admin rights). The exe isn't code-signed, so Windows SmartScreen may warn you: click **More info → Run anyway**.
3. Optional: check the download against **`SHA256SUMS.txt`** (in PowerShell: `Get-FileHash Wolfbeat-VERSION-win64.exe`).

The full source code is attached as **Source code (zip / tar.gz)**.

## Features
- Plays MP3, FLAC, OGG, WAV, M4A and AAC from your music folders.
- One search box for Spotify, YouTube Music and YouTube; import Spotify playlists and albums by link.
- Liked songs, playlists, queue, shuffle and repeat; synced lyrics; a "Made for you" mix.
- Glass interface with animated backgrounds and taskbar play controls.

## Good to know
- Online search and playback read Spotify / YouTube web pages, so they can break when those sites change.
- Upgrading from Riff (Wolfbeat's old name)? Your library, likes and playlists move over automatically on first start.

Built automatically by GitHub Actions from commit COMMIT.
